# Append-only evidence record (issue #124). Add new dated entries below; do not edit old ones.
# Scope: RTL mutation check of the single LOGIC4 tile RTL (design/rtl/{lut4_slice,logic_tile,
#   logic_tile_routed,logic_tile_switch_matrix}.v) against the iverilog testbenches under sim/.
#   Each mutant is a single-point edit of a COPY in sim/build/mutation/; the committed RTL is untouched.
# Meaning: KILLED = at least one testbench reported non-PASS. ALLOWLISTED = survives and is justified
#   as equivalent in sim/mutation_allowlist.txt. Non-claims: a curated list, not exhaustive mutation
#   coverage; says nothing about timing, layout or the ratified (Wilton-class) fabric.
# Reproduce: ./sim/run.sh --mutation [--record]   (iverilog + python3; serial)
# Findings (first run, before sim/tb_logic_tile_gapfill.v existed): 4 mutants SURVIVED --
#   TILE_IN_SLICE_ROTATE, TILE_REGSEL_SLICE_SWAP (tb_logic_tile fed identical input nibbles to all
#   slices and used only reg_sel 0000/1111) and RT_SM_CFG_BIT157_TIED0 (no composed-tile bench routed
#   BEL3's EN from the S/W edges). Coverage holes closed by the new tb_logic_tile_gapfill.v.
#   RT_SR_SLICE_ROTATE is equivalent (shared SR net) and is allowlisted.
